title: AgentLite: A Lightweight Library for Building and Advancing Task-Oriented LLM Agent System
reason: Lightweight describes the software library; direct small-backbone evidence has not been established. Do not infer SLM relevance from the name.

title: AgentInstruct: Toward Generative Teaching with Agentic Flows
reason: Agentic data generation is not by itself evaluation of a small agent policy. Need a specific connection before inclusion.

title: Mobile-Agent-v2: Mobile Device Operation Assistant with Effective Navigation via Multi-Agent Collaboration
reason: Relevant architecture, but a small-model result is not established in this review. Not imported into the SLM catalog merely for being multi-agent.

title: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs with Preference Data
reason: Useful routing foundation; prioritize direct trajectory-level SLM-agent routing first. Query routing alone does not establish agent routing performance.

title: Arch-Router: Aligning LLM Routing with Human Preferences
reason: Compact router is relevant background but is not itself a small language model agent. Direct trajectory-level evidence needs review.
